items.name: Ashfield Summer Challenge 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3hrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ae8bf56bdf7df2a9ddef232b67ef1762d8b05535/logo_200x200.png) This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England. The only events at this competition will be 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Multiple Blindfolded, 3x3x3 Fewest Moves, 4x4x4 Blindfolded, and 5x5x5 blindfolded. First-time competitors are welcome, however we will not be holding the normal speedsolving events, and so you may prefer to attend a different competition. * [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.cubenewengland.com) * [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.cubenewengland.com/competitions) * [Follow us on **Facebook**](https://facebook.com/cubenewengland) * [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/402975042172435) * [Join our Facebook community for **parents**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/732527678812618) * [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/3mX6xKUdRC)

items.name: Edinburgh Summer Beginners 2024
items.information: This competition is targeted at **first-time competitors and less experienced competitors**, but everyone is welcome. Please note that while this competition is open to anyone to attend, **only competitors who have attended 2 or fewer competitions before will be eligible for medals**. PLEASE NOTE: This is a Series Competition with [Edinburgh Summer Open 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EdinburghSummerOpen2024). You may only attend ONE of these competitions. Please see further details on the [Series Competition tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EdinburghSummerOpen2024#40344-series-competition). Please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. items.name: Kalaallit Nunaat 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2syIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--421be8dcbd6a4e0e29893d46b60668a278a829ce/image.png) * This is the second speedcubing competition recognized by the WCA in Nuuk! * The competition happens on Sunday June 23rd but a workshop will happen on Saturday 22nd from 16 to 19. Join us for a good time with other cubers, to learn new techniques and be ready for timing yourself on Sunday afternoon! * The competition is a fun way to time yourself and have official results recognized by the World Cube Association! You will be called to do 5 timed solves, your best time and worst times are removed and your ranking is determined by the average of the 3 remaining times! All you need is to be able to solve the cube in less than 10 minutes, we will help you with this during the workshop! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb1kyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--050293ccbaf021bc31fec3d8a961df60e1d36ac7/image.png) * Una Nuummi Speedcubing-imik unamminerup aappassaraa World Cube Association-imiit akuerisaq! * Unammineq sapaammi 23. juni ualikkut nal. 13:10-19:45 piumaarpoq, pinnginneranilu pikkorissarneq arfiningornermi 22. juni nal. 16:00 19:00 aamma sapaammi 23. juni nal. 12-13 ingerlanneqassalluni. Piffissami nuannersumi peqatigisigut, allanik aamma cubertartunik peqataasoqarumaarpoq. Periusinik nutaanik ilinniarit, imminullu piffissalersornissannut sapaammi. * Unamminermi nuannersumik imminut piffissalersussaatit inerniliussallu World Cube Associationimiit akuerisaasussaassallutik. Tallimariarlutit piffissalersussaatit, pitsaanerpaaq ajornerpaarlu peerpata sinneruttut pingasut inernerisa agguaqatigiisinnera unamminermi inissitsiternermi sumiinnersutit inissikkumaarlugu. Anguniagaq tassaaginnarpoq minutsit qulit iluanni terningip naammassisinnaanngornissaa. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb2cyIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3511d693f3962fa6f0a96bf67ebafa277e88e75e/image.png) * Dette er den anden speedcubing konkurrence som er anerkendt af World Cube Association i Nuuk! * Konkurrencen finder sted søndag den 23. juni om eftermiddagen kl.13:10-19:45 , før konkurrencen vil der være en workshop lørdag den 22. fra kl. 16-19 og søndag fra kl.12-13. Tag med os til en god tid sammen med andre cubers, for at lære nye teknikker og være klar til at time dig selv søndag eftermiddag. * Konkurrencen er en sjov måde at time dig selv og få officielle resultater anerkendt af World Cube Association! Du vil blive kaldt til at lave 5 tidsbestemte løsninger, din bedste tid og værste tider fjernes, og din placering bestemmes af gennemsnittet af de 3 resterende gange! Det eneste du skal bruge er at kunne løse kuben på under 10 minutter, det hjælper vi dig med under workshoppen!
